يستعجب (form X)
# يَسْتَعْجِبُ (yastaʕjibu) /jas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# يُسْتَعْجَبُ (yustaʕjabu) /jus.taʕ.d͡ʒa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# يَسْتَعْجِبَ (yastaʕjiba) /jas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
